summary: Shared dataset + faithful web.py legacy Open Library target with quirks D-1..D-5
prompt: Read docs/SPEC.md first; it is the binding contract. Use only the project venv (.venv/bin/python, .venv/bin/pytest); do not install new packages and do not modify files under tests/ or docs/. Keep code clean, typed, documented, and production quality. Do not touch .switch-infra/ or .native/. Implement SPEC §1 (targets/common/dataset.py) and SPEC §2+§3(legacy column)+§5: targets/legacy_openlibrary/infogami_shim.py, targets/legacy_openlibrary/openlibrary/__init__.py, targets/legacy_openlibrary/openlibrary/plugins/__init__.py, targets/legacy_openlibrary/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/__init__.py, targets/legacy_openlibrary/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/lists.py, targets/legacy_openlibrary/server.py (argparse --port default 9001, --host default 127.0.0.1; cheroot via web.py, numthreads=30). The lists.py must look like real Open Library plugin code (delegate.page subclasses with path/encoding attributes, web.input, web.data, web.header) because another agent AST-parses it to extract routes. Legacy D-5 must be a genuine unhandled ZeroDivisionError reaching web.py's default internalerror handler (web.config.debug=False) — do not fake the 500. Make sure the server process exits cleanly on SIGTERM.
